description: Start here to test a mobile app (Android/iOS): finds or builds the app, picks an emulator/simulator, runs prepare > smoke > explore > report > suite as a job (mode:"execute", default; pass waitForCompletion:true or poll qa_job_status). mode:"plan" only plans, no side effects. One consent covers boot/install/build; every terminal state has a report. iOS without WDA: visual-only smoke.

buildIfNeeded.description: Build from source when no artifact exists (default true).

explore.description: execute: run guided exploration after the smoke.

fastSmoke.description: Launch + smoke only, no suite (ignored with goal/generateSuite).

generateSuite.description: execute: also generate a POM suite from the run.

goal.description: Default: smoke, then a suite ("smoke" is fastest). Presets explore/generateSuite/stopOnNeedsInput; explicit flags win.

goalText.description: reproduce_bug: the bug/flow to focus on.

mode.description: execute (default, job) | plan (no side effects) | interactive (until the first question).

responseMode.description: compact = summary + URIs only; kept as the session default for later calls.

stopOnNeedsInput.description: execute: ask for login/test data instead of testing pre-login only.

timeoutMs.description: waitForCompletion window (default 45000, max 50000; SWIPIUM_MAX_WAIT_MS raises both; larger values are clamped); still running after it > state:"running" + jobId, poll qa_job_status.

name: qa_test_this

state.description: running | completed | blocked | unsafe | needs_input | ready

title: Test this app (autopilot)
